newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran clears British diplomat of spy charge - paper.
newsitem.headline: Iran clears British diplomat of spy charge - paper.

text.p: Iran has no evidence to implicate Britain's top diplomat in Tehran of spying as charged by an Iranian newspaper, the Islamic republic's foreign ministry on Wednesday was quoted as saying.

"An informed source at the Iranian Foreign Ministry told Iran News yesterday that there was no evidence, documentary or otherwise, to implicate the British official," the English-language daily reported.
Jeffrey James, charge d'affaires at the British embassy in Tehran, was accused by the newspaper Kayhan on Monday of being a member of the British intelligence service MI6.
The hardline daily quoted an unnamed French diplomat as telling its sister weekly Kayhan Havai in Paris that James belonged to MI6.

James was one of the European Union ambassadors recalled from Tehran in a diplomatic row over a German court charge that Iranian leaders ordered the 1992 killings of Kurdish dissidents in Berlin. Iran has denied involvement.
